#4192 Export button stays greyed out after a failed export
Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The ExportButton component manages a `busy` state to disable the export button during an export operation. When the exportReport function is called, it sets `busy` to true and upon successful completion, sets `busy` back to false. However, if the exportReport promise rejects (for example, when the server returns an error), the `busy` state is never reset to false, leaving the Export button disabled (greyed out) and unclickable. This explains why after a failed export, the button remains greyed out until the entire page is reloaded. A fix would involve adding error handling in the exportReport promise chain to reset `busy` to false on failure as well, allowing the button to be re-enabled for retry.
